listings.description: Located in the heart of Leesburg, this 1932 Victorian offers 3 bedrooms, 2.5 baths, and approximately 2,242 square feet of living space. The home features original architectural details, recently refinished hardwood floors, fresh interior paint, a large covered front porch, a rear sunroom, and beautiful natural light in every room. Large walkthrough closets with built-in shelving lead to each full bathroom upstairs; the additional bedroom closets plus linen closet provide plentiful storage space. The land has been organically tended by a certified Master Gardener since 1999. Situated on a quarter-acre lot in an established neighborhood, the property is conveniently and centrally situated: it is less than a mile from historic downtown Leesburg's shops and restaurants, within half a mile of two grocery stores and Catoctin Elementary School, less than a mile from Loudoun County High School and the W&OD Trail, and with easy access to Route 7, Route 15, and Route 267. The home retains much of its original character but requires additional improvements. The bathrooms need renovation, the roof requires repair, and the basement has experienced water intrusion. The seller is aware of the property's condition and has priced it accordingly. The 2026 tax-assessed value is $807,020, compared with the asking price of $650,000 - a difference of more than $157,000, or approximately 19.5% below the assessed value. The property is being sold strictly AS-IS, presenting an opportunity for a buyer to make improvements while preserving the character of this historic Leesburg home.
